$comment: Maps each smoke-test env to the chains it covers. The harness reads SMOKE_RPC_<ENV>_<KIND> for each chain (e.g. SMOKE_RPC_STAGING_ACCOUNTING). 'rpcSource' is documentation only — staging uses Tenderly vnets, preprod/prod use real mainnet RPCs. 'network' is the human label (arbitrum/ethereum/...), used for banners and report keys. Add more earning chains by appending to the chains array.
